algolia.name: BenQ - 24" LED HD Monitor - Black/Red
algolia.description: Take your gaming up a notch with this BenQ XL2411Z 24" LED monitor, which offers an ultrafast 1 ms response time to minimize blurring, streaking and ghosting in fast-paced movies and games. Enjoy games and browse the Web in crisp, 1080p resolution.
